scripts.serve: cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.1 --project demo-payb2 emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.check:deploy: node --check index.js && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.test: node --test test/debt-notifications.test.js test/scheduled-occurrences.test.js test/device-notifications.test.js test/usage-limits.test.js test/notification-event-policy.test.js
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.1 --project demo-payb2-rules emulators:exec --only firestore "npm --prefix functions run test:rules:run"
scripts.test:demo: cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.1 --project demo-payb2 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "env PAYB2_DEMO_SMOKE=true node --test functions/test/local-emulators.test.js"
scripts.test:integration: cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.1 --project demo-payb2-functions emulators:exec --only firestore "npm --prefix functions run test:integration:run"
